senses.gloss: f.(b. h. צְלֹחִית)flask, bottle with a wide belly and a narrow neck.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 12:2">Par. XII, 2</cite>. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 5 <he>צ׳ המן וצ׳ של מי נדה וצ׳ וכ׳</he> the bottle containing the manna (<cite ref="Exodus 16:33">Ex. XVI, 33</cite>), that containing the sprinkling water (<cite ref="Numbers 19:9">Num. XIX, 9</cite>) &c.; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 21">B’shall. 21</cite> <he>צנצנת המן וצ׳ וכ׳</he>. Pesik. Vayhi, p. 3ᵇ (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 9:24">Ex. IX, 24</cite>) <he>צ׳ של ברד וכ׳</he> a bottle of hailstone filled with fire; a. e.—Pl. <he>צְלוֹחִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:11:1">Cant. R. to III, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:8">Num. R. s. 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:1:2">Y. Bets. IV, beg. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ צ׳</he> bottlewise.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:17">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 161">Yalk. Sam. 161</cite>; a. e.
